[[Sylar Saris]] was a member of an [[insectoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] '''species''' closely resembling the [[Yam'rii]] [[species]]. Saris' species was potentially a [[subspecies]] of Yam'rii.<ref name="EpisodeGuide" /> The species was capable of spitting green acid<ref name="BTAD" /> out of their mouths.<ref name="BadTerritory" />

==Sylar Saris' species in the galaxy==
Sylar Saris was a [[bounty hunter]]<ref name="BadTerritory" /> active during or after [[18 BBY]]<ref name="Date">{{TBBDate|308}}</ref> who was a member of the species.<ref name="EpisodeGuide" /> He was known as "The Slayer of [[Ordo Eris]]" and became highly sought after after killing a couple of top bosses of the [[Haxion Brood]] crime syndicate and escaping with a cache of [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]]. The bounty on Saris was eventually claimed by fellow bounty hunter [[Fennec Shand]], who was aided by former [[clone commando]]s [[Hunter]] and [[Wrecker]].<ref name="BadTerritory" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sylar Saris' species appeared in "[[Bad Territory]],"<ref name="BadTerritory" /> the eighth episode of ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'s'' [[The Bad Batch Season 3|third season]], which premiered on [[March 20]], [[2024]].<ref name="Watch">{{SW|url=news/the-bad-batch-season-3-trailer|text=Watch the ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' Season 3 Trailer}}</ref> The episode guide released the following day revealed Saris' species to be separate from the [[Yam'rii]] species, but instead suggested it may have been a subspecies.<ref name="EpisodeGuide" />
